Most enquiries are routine and most arrive when nobody is there. Serverlys agents answer them in the moment — in the chat on your website, on WhatsApp, by email and on the phone — capture what matters, and escalate the ones that need you.
An agent that only answers is a search box. The value is in what happens after the answer: the customer gets what they came for, and you get a record of who they are and what they need.

Chat that ends in a booking

ConvoAI sits in the messenger on your website and answers visitors from the content you gave it, in your tone. Hallucination prevention is built in, so when it does not have an answer it says so instead of inventing one. When the conversation turns into an order or a booking, it records the contact and tells you. Try the demo: it is scripted, but it follows the same path.
Website first. WhatsApp and email when you need them.
One agent, trained once, answering wherever your customers already write to you. Chat, WhatsApp and email conversations land in one shared inbox for your team.

A missed call is a lost customer far more often than a missed email. CallFlow is an AI receptionist for your business line: it answers, handles the routine questions from your knowledge base, books into your calendar, and transfers to a person when the call needs one. Setup is your business details, then the voice, routing and calendar, then forwarding your existing number or taking a new one.

The agent is there to take the routine off your hands, not to stand between your customers and you. When it reaches something it should not handle, it tells the customer, offers a person, and passes the conversation across with everything already said — so your team answers the actual question instead of asking it again.
What it handles, by type of business
The questions differ by trade; the shape is the same. Answer the routine, take the booking or the order, and pass the rest to you.

The agent is a trigger. What follows — creating the record, notifying the right person, adding it to the calendar — runs as a workflow you can see and change. ConvoAI Pro includes automation workflows and webhooks for Zapier, Make and n8n; for anything bigger, Serverlys builds and runs it for you.
